profitability.formula: revenue - (fuel + maintenanceProvision + fixedOverhead + loanPrincipal + loanInterest + otherBusinessCosts)

fuelCostPerKm.rule: full-tank intervals only; first full-tank fill establishes baseline; latest rolling observations are averaged

maintenance.rule: exactly one dimension per maintenance item: KM or TIME; provision and actual invoice remain separate

currency.rule: safe integer paise at monetary boundaries

loan.rule: amortization separates principal and interest; prepayment has zero prepayment charge

goldenPolicy: Every changed financial formula requires a deterministic regression vector before deployment.
